rows.title: Price movement
rows.summary: Significant movement in price has been observed in Advance Agrolife Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Advance Agrolife Limited has submitted their response.
